data.title: 帕瓦 · 晨光杂乱被窝的撒娇噘嘴
data.description: 早晨刺眼的阳光直射在杂乱无章的被窝上。帕瓦被子裹成一团，单边肩头露在外面，一件松垮的背心歪斜挂在身上，纤细的锁骨与光洁肩膀暴露无遗。红色的犄角陷在羽绒枕头里，她把脸埋在枕头里噘着嘴发出不满的哼哼声，一双金红十字眼从凌乱的金发缝隙里瞪着你，抱怨着太早起床必须要你给做大盘烤肉才肯动弹。
data.action: 被子裹成一团，单边肩头露在外面，一件松垮的背心歪斜挂在身上
data.location: cluttered apartment bedroom bathed in bright morning sunshine
data.lighting: harsh cheerful morning sunbeams highlighting floating dust and tousled blonde hair
data.promptProse: Burrowed amidst tangled blankets in a cluttered apartment bedroom at sunrise, Power wears an oversized pastel cat-ear fleece hoodie shrugged off one bare shoulder over a crooked tank top, sleep shorts, and fluffy striped socks. Glaring toward the viewer with tousled blonde hair and a fierce morning pout, she sits in bright morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Burrowed inside tangled morning bedsheets with her oversized pastel cat-ear hoodie and tank top slipping crookedly off one bare shoulder, she glares out through messy hair with a grumpy morning pout. Bright morning sunbeams slice through drifting bedroom dust.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an oversized pastel cat-ear fleece hoodie shrugged off one shoulder over a crooked tank top, comfy sleep shorts, and fluffy striped socks.
